environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster but namespace 'prod-ws' has Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' profile via namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The admission controller rejects pods with privileged securityContext, hostPath volumes, and requires runAsNonRoot. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-db-permissions' validates that any pod with label app=websocket-service must have an annotation specifying the PostgreSQL role, and the init container verifies the connected role has only SELECT on chat_history and users tables (no COPY, no pg_read_file, no superuser). The database credential injected via External Secrets Operator maps to a PostgreSQL role 'ws_readonly' with: GRANT SELECT(id, message, created_at) ON chat_history TO ws_readonly; GRANT SELECT(id, username) ON users TO ws_readonly; No additional grants. Row-level security enabled on all tables with policy restricting to rows where tenant_id matches the role's session variable.
